svg.text: Flasher on perfboard (seen from the component side)
Grey = bare solder bridge or wire under the board. Coloured = insulated wire. About 17 × 15 holes (about 43 × 38 mm).
Both transistors: flat side (white line) down.
2N3904 reads E B C, BC557B reads C B E.
The middle leg is always B.
The resistors stand upright: the large
circle is the body, the small one is
Blue crosses orange: both are insulated,
so they can lie on top of each other.
The D1 mini sits on pin headers. The wires under the module run on the underside of the board.
Note: when you turn the board over to solder, everything is mirrored left to right.
Before USB: check with a continuity tester that 3V3 and GND are not shorted, and that J1 VCC does not beep against GND.
